# MCP Bridges (iscvlab/mcp-bridges)

> Production CAD, GIS, and vector design Model Context Protocol (MCP) skill suite for **any AI coding agent — cloud, IDE, CLI, or local LLM (`Ollama`, `vLLM`, `LM Studio`, `OpenHands`, `Cline`, `Continue`, `Aider`, `Claude Code`, `Codex`, `Cursor`, `Grok`, `Gemini / Antigravity`, or custom agent frameworks)** on **Windows, macOS, and Linux** across Rhinoceros 3D, Grasshopper (GH1), QGIS Desktop (PyQGIS), Adobe Illustrator, and Figma, hardened with `/xultra` Single-Mouse GUI serialization. Selected for the XERJ Corpus Hub (`hub.xerj.org`, `144` resolved `xerj autoindex` graph edges; upstream contributions in `xerj-org/xerj` PRs `#2922`–`#2927`).

## One-Prompt Universal Agent Install

```text
Install iscvlab/mcp-bridges (https://github.com/iscvlab/mcp-bridges): detect my OS and your active global or workspace skills directory, clone the repository, install the 7 CAD/GIS/Vector MCP skills (Windows: ./scripts/install.ps1 -All; macOS/Linux: ./scripts/install.sh --all; or copy skills/* directly into your active skills folder), check which desktop MCP servers (Rhino, Grasshopper, QGIS, Illustrator, Figma) are configured in my MCP settings, and report what was verified vs. what still needs a live desktop session.
```

## Quickstart & Universal Install

- [README.md](README.md): Architecture, measured benchmarks, one-prompt agent installer, and universal agent verification table (`tested` on Antigravity Windows 11; `spec-compatible` across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, and local LLM agents).
- [scripts/install.ps1](scripts/install.ps1): Windows PowerShell installer (`./scripts/install.ps1 -All` or `-Target <dir>`).
- [scripts/install.sh](scripts/install.sh): macOS and Linux installer (`./scripts/install.sh --all` or `--target <dir>`, copies directories by default for `xerj autoindex --skills` compatibility).

## Skills & Reference Documentation

- [skills/qgis/SKILL.md](skills/qgis/SKILL.md): Geospatial PyQGIS automation, metric UTM `EPSG:32647` geoprocessing, `.qml` cartography, and print layout export.
- [skills/qgis/references/tree_surgery_protocol.md](skills/qgis/references/tree_surgery_protocol.md): SIP C++ pointer crash prevention (`QgsLayerTreeRegistryBridge.setEnabled(False)`) during layer tree reordering.
- [skills/rhino/SKILL.md](skills/rhino/SKILL.md): 3D NURBS/SubD/Mesh modeling, `spawn_slot` multi-instance isolation, and RhinoCommon C#/Python execution (`Rhino-MCP-Platform` `v0.3.0`).
- [skills/grasshopper/SKILL.md](skills/grasshopper/SKILL.md): Parametric `g1_*` canvas wiring, deferred batch solving (`solve=false` -> `g1_solve_graph`, `18.5x` faster), and data tree surgery.
- [skills/rhino-alias/SKILL.md](skills/rhino-alias/SKILL.md): Persistent RhinoPython command alias authoring and Dual-OS `! _-RunPythonScript` macro generation.
- [skills/components-log/SKILL.md](skills/components-log/SKILL.md): Grasshopper C# (`Script_Instance`) registry parser and Markdown/JSON synchronizer.
- [skills/components-log/scripts/update_log.py](skills/components-log/scripts/update_log.py): Single-component C# `RunScript` signature and parameter header parser.
- [skills/components-log/scripts/batch_update.py](skills/components-log/scripts/batch_update.py): Multi-layer batch scanner for Grasshopper C# component directories.
- [skills/illustrator/SKILL.md](skills/illustrator/SKILL.md): Swiss vector plate layout, typographic hierarchy, and ascending Z-order-safe grouping via ExtendScript MCP.
- [skills/figma/SKILL.md](skills/figma/SKILL.md): Bidirectional HTML-to-Design (`port 8765`) and Figma Auto-Layout synchronization.
